title: Heart Sutra, Part 3: The Skandhas
speaker: Nomon Tim Burnett
summary: Nomon Tim Burnett takes up the opening of the Heart Sutra, where Avalokiteshvara perceives that all five skandhas are empty and so relieves all suffering. Nomon walks through the five aggregates (form, feeling tone, perception, mental formations, and consciousness) as an alternate model of a person that needs no "me in the middle." A guided meditation finds earth, water, fire, and wind in the body, and Lisa Feldman Barrett's story of a soldier who sees a boy's herding stick as an AK-47 shows the mind building what it sees. Nomon closes by previewing emptiness as a reality too large for any bucket of concepts, the skandhas included.
